title: ‘Socheton’: A Culturally Appropriate AI Tool to Support Reproductive Well-being
reasoning: The paper centrally explores the intersection of healthcare technology with religious (specifically Islamic) and spiritual beliefs in Bangladesh. It discusses how faith-based practices, the role of religious leaders (Imams), and spiritual traditions (such as 'Kabiraji') impact the acceptance of reproductive health information and sets a primary design goal of making AI tools culturally and religiously appropriate.
